summary: Split-line PO invoice allocations dropped when CSV uses comma as decimal separator — 3-way match fails
description:
Issue summary:
During an AP bulk invoice upload, several invoices with split-line allocations failed automated 3-way PO match and were held for manual review. The CSV provided by the customer success finance team used commas as decimal separators for percentage allocations (e.g., '50,0' instead of '50.0'), which the CSV ingest routine interpreted as thousands/thousands-separator or truncated, resulting in 0% allocation for those lines. As a result, the invoice line totals did not match PO line expectations and payment processing blocked the batch.

Impact:
- 14 invoices from the bulk upload (vendor: Skyline Analytics, PO: PO-2026-3321) were moved to 'manual review' and not included in the scheduled payout cut on 2026-03-12.
- AP team had to perform manual allocation and re-run approvals, delaying payments to the vendor.
- Potential vendor relationship risk if payments are further delayed.

Observed behavior:
- CSV ingest accepts both '.' and ',' in numeric fields but downstream allocation parser normalizes only '.' as decimal separator. Lines with '50,0' were parsed as '500' or '0' depending on code path, leaving allocation sums at 0.
- 3-way match returns mismatch error: "Allocation sum does not equal invoice line total".

Expected behavior:
- CSV ingestion should detect locale-style decimal separators and normalize allocations correctly (treat '50,0' as 50.0%).
- Validation should fail fast on upload with clear error indicating malformed numeric fields (instead of silently producing zero allocations).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Prepare a CSV invoice upload with split-line allocations and use comma decimal separator for percentages (example: "50,0"; see attached sample CSV).
2) Upload to AP bulk invoice ingest (Console > Finance > Invoice upload).
3) Observe ingest report and post-ingest matching results.
4) Check resulting invoice status and 3-way match logs; note allocation sums and mismatch errors.
logs:
Sample error lines from ingestion logs (prod-us-east):
- ingest/csv-parser: parsed value '50,0' for column 'allocation_percent' -> normalized to '50' then cast to int -> downstream math produced 0 allocation for decimals.
- matching/three-way: PO-PO-2026-3321-line-2: allocation_sum(0) != invoice_line_total(1500.00) -> status HELD_FOR_REVIEW (code 0x3WM_MISMATCH).
- payments/scheduler: excluded invoice INV-2026-8843 from payout batch '2026-03-12-AP'.

Full logfile snippets and sample CSV uploaded to internal S3: s3://redwood-support-prod/artifacts/INT-686512/
investigation_notes:
Initial triage by AP tooling engineer (Marco) and payments SRE (Leah):
- Reproduced locally with sample CSV using en-GB vs pt-BR style numbers.
- Root cause: csv-parser uses fast-csv library configured with 'strictNumbers: true' which strips non-numeric characters; locale handling was not enabled. Allocation parsing pipeline then casts to integer or uses integer division in an older helper function, dropping fractional allocations.
- Edge-case: when thousands separator is comma and decimal separator is period, parser works. When decimal separator is comma (common for locales in APAC/EMEA vendors/partners), our ingest treats the comma as a delimiter and drops fractional part.
- Workaround identified: upload with '.' decimal separator or pre-process CSV to replace '([0-9]),([0-9])' -> '$1.$2'.
- Linked slack thread: #ap-helpdesk (thread ts: 2026-03-12T15:12) and internal ticket INT-45211 referenced for similar allocation UI validation ask.
comments: Aisha Patel (Reporter) - 2026-03-12: Raised after AP batch failure during vendor payout window. Attached sample CSV and one affected invoice PDF.
Marco Ruiz (Assignee) - 2026-03-13: Confirmed parser behavior in staging; can reproduce. Adding payment hold log excerpt to ticket. Will raise a PR to normalize numeric fields at ingest.

Leah Gomez (SRE) - 2026-03-13: Temporary mitigation: patched staging ingest to run a normalization pass; scheduled to roll to prod as hotfix if QA passes. Noted potential perf impact for very large batches.
Finance Ops (AP Team) - 2026-03-13: Applied manual fix for 14 invoices and retriggered approvals; requested ETA for permanent fix before next scheduled mass upload on 2026-03-19.
resolution_notes:
Temporary workaround: AP team re-exported CSV with '.' as decimal separator and re-uploaded; manual corrections done for affected invoices to release payments.
Permanent fix plan:
- Merge PR #1245: add normalization pass to csv-parser (detect comma decimals, attempt locale-aware parse), add validation error on upload when totals/allocations don't sum, and surface row-level errors in UI.
- Add unit tests for pt-BR, de-DE, en-US numeric formats.
- Post-deploy: create an automated job to scan previous week uploads for malformed numeric fields.
Follow-up tasks assigned to eng-invoice (task: ENG-INV-798) and AP tooling to update upload docs for customers. Hotfix QA passed in staging; target prod deploy 2026-03-16 behind a feature flag.
